participants.population: University of Virginia undergraduate economics students

symmetric_public_draw_after_position_4.note: The article explicitly states that two public draws were inserted after the fourth prediction in sessions 4 and 5.

unimplemented_public_draw_session.reason: The paper reports a third public-draw session but does not describe its public-draw timing or participant-facing procedure.

steps: Read the participant instructions and explain the treatment-specific urn composition.
Run unpaid public practice periods until urn A and urn B have each been selected at least once; show the die result, selected urn, and all draws, and request no predictions.
For each of 15 paid periods, select urn A or urn B with equal probability.
Generate one private light or dark draw with replacement for each of six decision makers.
Randomize the order in which the six decision makers act.
Ask each decision maker to predict urn A or urn B after showing only their private draw, earlier public predictions, and any public draws available at that position.
In published sessions 4 and 5, reveal two additional draws after prediction 4 and before positions 5 and 6 decide.
Announce each prediction before approaching the next decision maker.
Reveal the selected urn after all six predictions and award $2 to each correct decision maker.
Prevent communication among decision makers during the experiment.

runtime.partial_runs: A requested multiple of six executes a prefix of the published evidence-complete session schedule.
